prompt: In which year did a team achieve the highest score in a World Baseball Classic (WBC) championship game, leading them to victory in their first-ever WBC final?
answer: **2006** — Japan defeated Cuba **10–6** in the inaugural WBC championship game, scoring the highest winning total in a WBC final and claiming its first-ever WBC title.
